Maya G: Hey team — quick ask. Can I enable a 30min staging request+response dump to replay a flaky embeddings regression on checkout? Need full bodies to reproduce the tokenization mismatch.

Samir K: What's the exact scope and who will have access? Sensitive data in bodies?

Maya G: Only in staging cluster 'stg-checkout' for that service. Will stream to a temporary S3 bucket in our staging account. Retention 2h, then auto-delete. Access: me + leo. Mostly user-supplied text, could include emails/phone numbers and auth tokens in headers.

Leo I: If you do this make sure to HMAC filenames and enable KMS encryption on the bucket. Also block public access.

Maya G: OK — plan is: bucket stg-debug-<hmac>, server-side KMS, IAM limited to my role + leo. Will also run the scrubber before anyone downloads.

Samir K: Before you turn it on we need a config snippet of what you plan to capture and the scrub rules. Also must redact Authorization and any bearer tokens in bodies. No raw tokens stored even temporarily.

Maya G: Config I'm planning (example):
```json
{
  "capture": ["request.headers", "request.body", "response.body"],
  "redact": ["Authorization", "token", "access_token"],
  "post_process": "run-llm-scrubber --regex 'email|phone'",
  "retention_minutes": 120
}
```

Samir K: Looks close. A few changes: 1) change post_process to a predefined pipeline `privacy-scrub-v2` (it pseudonymizes emails/phones), 2) require filename HMAC using request-id, 3) add explicit ACL list (Maya, Leo), 4) no human access until scrub completes unless approved.

Maya G: Got it. I'll switch to `privacy-scrub-v2`, HMAC filenames, set ACL to only me + leo, and mark "no-unrestricted-download": true. One ask: can you pre-approve emergency access for me to pull raw payload if scrub fails? I'll file a short ticket.

Samir K: Emergency raw access only with 2FA + audit-log entry + approval from myself. If you file the ticket include justification and replay steps. With those controls, you have my ✅. :lock: :hourglass_flowing_sand:

audit-bot: Policy reminder — temporary captures must not exceed 240 minutes and must be logged in the access register. Auto-delete scheduled.

Maya G: Thanks — will proceed now with the `stg-debug-` bucket and post the playbook + ticket link once it's created. :thumbsup:
